mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.REP_ID as code, A.REPORT_NAME as shortName FROM REP_INFO A
A.REPORT_NAME like concat_ws(concat_ws('%',#{param, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
order by A.REPORT_NAME

select A.REP_ID repId, A.TEMPLATE_ID templateId, A.TEMPLATE_NAME templateName, A.TEMPLATE_PATH templatePath, A.REPORT_NAME reportName, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.REPORT_TYPE reportType, A.REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory, rfp.NAME reportCategoryName from REP_INFO A left join REP_FTP_PATH rfp on A.REPORT_CATEGORY=rfp.ID
A.REPORT_NAME like concat_ws(concat_ws('%',#{reportName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
AND A.REPORT_CATEGORY IN
#{item}
order by A.UPDATE_TIME DESC

select screen_index screenIndex, screen_Id screenId, rep_Id repId, screen_Type screenType, screen_Key screenKey, screen_Name screenName, screen_Value screenValue, screen_Status screenStatus from Rep_Screen R where R.rep_Id = #{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT ri.REP_ID as repId, ri.REPORT_NAME as reportName FROM REP_INFO ri WHERE ri.REPORT_TYPE='Y'
select rjr.RULE_TYPE1 as ruleType1, rjr.RULE_TYPE2 as ruleType2, rjr.RULE_TYPE3 as ruleType3, rjr.RULE_TYPE4 as ruleType4 from REP_JOB_RANGE rjr where rjr.JOB_ID=#{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
